what_happened: The Canadian club platform was named as the partner, with an owner, a purpose and its consent fields identified. Minors are present.
The raw API dump was landed as-is and profiled. Issues found: repeated records across pages, and a new member id when a player switches clubs.
The contract fixes the schema, keys, personal-data classes, consent fields and quality thresholds.
Staging dedupes the repeated pages and types every field; contract validation passes or each warning is accepted in writing.
Records are resolved into people and counted by club, so Canada can be read like for like.
Canada has a status, a counting grade and a direction on the Global outlook tab.
Decided before any data: Italy is asked for the minimum return (counts only), never for player-level records. Regime questions go to the privacy lead.
On a copy of the warehouse: a synthetic first return for the latest season is landed as-is.
The template contract is ready to copy for Italy's federation, with the checks it runs before sending.
On the copy: the return passes every template check and is typed in staging.
On the copy: Italy moves from dark to partial, and its planning scenario is retired.
Waits for a real return from Italy's federation. The published tab keeps Italy dark.
